scenarios.condition: Output directory already exists prior to publication
Output directory is relative or contains '..' path traversal
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('output_dir must be a fully-qualified Windows path')

scenarios.condition: Output directory parent is an unsafe reparse point / junction
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Parent directory of output root is an unsafe reparse point')

scenarios.condition: bundle_filename is not 'operator_startup_pair.json' or contains slashes
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Only fixed basename operator_startup_pair.json is supported')

scenarios.condition: Supplied config path does not exist on disk
Supplied config path is an unsafe reparse point / symlink
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... is an unsafe reparse point / symlink')

scenarios.condition: Supplied config path does not match descriptor expectedConfigPath under Windows path equality
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... config path does not match descriptor expectedConfigPath')

scenarios.condition: Actual raw config file SHA-256 differs from descriptor expectedConfigSha256
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... config SHA mismatch: declared vs actual')

scenarios.condition: Config file begins with UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM)
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... contains prohibited UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM)')

scenarios.condition: Config JSON contains duplicate property names
Config JSON has missing or unknown root properties outside exact 14
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... missing required property' or '... contains unknown root property')

scenarios.condition: validatorArguments in config JSON is non-blank
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... validatorArguments must be blank in paired mode')

scenarios.condition: Parent role is not 'SIMULATION' or child role is not 'READ_ONLY'
Config configId or capabilityBoundary does not match declaration
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... configId mismatch' or '... capabilityBoundary mismatch')

scenarios.condition: Target final bundle already exists when os.link is attempted
scenarios.behavior: Raises FileExistsError (os.link fails closed without overwrite)
scenarios.destructive_cleanup: None (staging and sidecar files preserved as partial evidence)
